messages.subject: Re: Can I get the value of deviance information criteria (DIC)?
parts: Can I get the value of deviance information criteria (DIC)?

Are you using blavaan?  DIC is a Bayesian analog of AIC.  If you are using MLE, then look at AIC. If you are using blavaan for Bayesian estimation, you can get DIC and WAIC using the fitMeasures() function.

Terry
